Now Q3:

**Question:** When an import contains an address you've already saved, what should happen to the existing bookmark?

**Why it matters:** This defines the outcome of re-importing or merging collections (FR-031, SC-008) — whether your existing tags/notes are protected, enriched, or overwritten.

**Recommended:** Option B — merging non-destructively (add any new tags from the file, keep the earliest saved date, and never overwrite a note/description you've already written) preserves your work while still absorbing useful data from the import.

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| A | **Skip** — leave the existing bookmark untouched; ignore the incoming duplicate entirely |
| B | **Merge non-destructively** — union the tags, keep the earliest saved date, and preserve existing title/description/note (only fill fields that are currently empty) |
| C | **Overwrite** — replace the existing bookmark's fields with the imported values |

You can reply with the option letter, accept the recommendation by saying "yes" or "recommended", or provide your own short answer.
